This page brings together everything Digital Humanities at the University of Bern offers in the spring semester 2027 (FS 2027): seminars and colloquia, the online lecture, the workshops of the *Applied Digital Humanities* modules, and the meetings for students in their final year and in the doctoral programme.

- **Lecture period:** 22 February – 4 June 2027
- **Easter break:** 26 March – 4 April 2027 (no teaching)
- **Whit Monday:** 17 May 2027 (no teaching)
- **Registration:** all courses are booked via [KSL](https://www.ksl.unibe.ch/KSL/home); the course number is given for each course. Course material is made available on [ILIAS](https://ilias.unibe.ch/).
- **Questions about the study programmes:** Adrian Demleitner, head of study programmes ([adrian.demleitner@unibe.ch](mailto:adrian.demleitner@unibe.ch))

::: {.callout-note}
There is no DH Lab in the spring semester. The final-year meetings take place as separate dates (see [below](#final-year-and-doctoral-programme)).
:::

## Applied Digital Humanities: workshops

The workshops belong to the submodules *Publishing, Preserving, Presenting* (PPP) and *Project Management* (ProjM). Each workshop is worth 0.5 ECTS and is booked individually in KSL. Registration closes on the Friday of the week before the workshop.

| Date | Time | Workshop | Submodule | Instructors | KSL |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wed 17 March 2027 | 09:00–12:30 | Data Management I: Active Research Data Management | PPP | Ursula Loosli, Gero Schreier | 515972 |
| Wed 17 March 2027 | 13:30–17:00 | Data Management II: Publishing Data | PPP | Ursula Loosli, Gero Schreier | 515974 |

| Wed 5 May 2027 | 09:00–13:00 | Publishing and Re-using Images: Introduction to the International Image Interoperability Framework (IIIF) | PPP | Ursula Loosli | 516158 |
